questions.topic: eGurukul · Hypertrophic Pyloric Stenosis & Hirschsprung Disease
questions.stem: As a JR-1 on rounds, you examine a neonate born 36 hours ago via full-term vaginal delivery; the mother is worried about the newborn not having passed meconium. Based on the examination, you think of Hirschsprung disease as the provisional diagnosis for the neonate's condition. Which of the following statements justify your diagnosis of the same?

options.label: A
options.text: In long-segment disease – aganglionosis extends from the sigmoid to the rectum

options.label: B
options.text: Transition zone is seen on Contrast enema in Hirschsprung disease

options.label: C
options.text: Aganglionic segment is dilated in Hirschsprung disease

options.label: D
options.text: Diagnostic modality for Hirschsprung is Barium Contrast enema
